QuestInfo.name: Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing I
QuestInfo.0: You hear that you can receive help from #b#p1002001##k in Lith Harbor...
QuestInfo.1:
You meet #b#p1002001##k at Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k says you remind him of when he was younger, and he wants to help you. He says that he will recognize your potential and support you if you bring him #b100 #t4000016#s#k and #b50#t4000004#s#k... For an awesome adventurer like you, this should be a piece of cake. 

#t4000016# #b#c4000016#/100#k
#t4000004# #b#c4000004#/50#k
QuestInfo.2: You showed your potential to #b#p1002001##k, who you met in Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k recognized your potential and gave you some mesos that should come handy during your adventures.

0.0: Hey there, you. Are you going on an adventure? When I was young, I used to explore the world, too. Ah, I miss those days. There is nothing more exciting than exploring the world.
0.1: At first, it was tough because I didn't fully prepare myself and I had zero experience. You remind me of those days. I struggled quite a bit back then.
0.2: I like you, kid. If you prove your competence to me, I'll support you on your adventures. What do you say?

yes.0: Good. Bring me #b100 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k. You will gain my recognition then.

no.0: Oh? Well, alright. I was just trying to help. Talk to me again if you change your mind.

1.0: Wow, unbelievable! That was really fast. I knew you were different. You'll make one heck of an adventurer in the future. I just know it!

yes.0: Did you receive the money? I know it isn't much, but it'll come in handy since you're about to embark on a new adventure. I'm looking forward to seeing the new and improved you in the near future.

item.0: I guess you haven't finished collecting everything. Did I overestimate you? Come on, bring me #b100 #t4000016#s#k and 50 #b#t4000004#s#k already. I know you can do it!
